verdict.rationale: Apify provides API/CLI access to retrieve run results and manage data programmatically (apify-docs-15, apify-docs-16, apify-probe-4, apify-probe-2), which implies some data portability, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents dataset export in open formats like CSV/JSON/XML or a clear 'export and leave' workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dataset export formats (CSV/JSON/XML/Excel), guidance on fully exporting all account data, and independent confirmation of a clean migration-out path.
